args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified. Root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures still needs investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the health check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: The root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures still needs investigation, which I've flagged in the incident summary.
